together.says: Babona ushintsho ngalunye njengoba lwenziwa, futhi benze olwabo. Wonke umuntu ugcina ikhophi yakhe.
together.days: Izinguquko zilinda izinsuku ezi-7 kulabo abangekho.
together.moves: Uma ukhipha umuntu noma uvala isixhumanisi, bonke asebengene bahamba nawe; kuphela abangakajoyini abadinga isixhumanisi esisha. Lokho umuntu asenakho kuhlala kungokwakhe.
together.newcomer: Akukho okufakwayo, ayikho i-akhawunti. Wonke umuntu ugcina ikhophi yakhe, kudivayisi yakhe.
together.removed: Awusekho kulokhu: “{title}”. Lokho onakho kuhlala kungokwakho.
together.stopped: Ukusebenza ndawonye kulokhu kumile: “{title}”. Ikhophi yakho ihlala ingeyakho.
together.inside: Inhlangano yakho yengeza abantu abasohlwini lwayo. Cela ukumenywa ngegama.
together.gone: Lesi sixhumanisi asisavuli lutho. Cela osithumele esinye esisha.
together.sentAsk: Kubuziwe. Bazonquma ukuthi umsizi wabo uyaphendula yini.
together.mineSays: Kuhambisana kuwo wonke amadivayisi akho njengoba kushintsha, ngaphandle kwesixhumanisi futhi ngaphandle komunye umuntu.
together.projectSays: Amadokhumenti ayo, amaqoqo, amaslayidi, amadizayini namafayela kuhlala kufana kuwo wonke umuntu okuyo. Imisebenzi yomuntu ngamunye, nalokho umsizi {name} akukhumbulayo ngaye, kuhlala kungokwakhe.
